name: Firecrawl Codespace
postCreateCommand: echo 'Firecrawl Codespace created. Services will start via docker compose.'
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/firecrawl && docker compose -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.codespaces.yml up -d && echo 'Waiting for Firecrawl API...' && timeout 300 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3002/v0/health/liveness; do sleep 2; done' && echo 'Firecrawl API ready'
